title: Joseph Joseph GripGrater Paddle Grater/Zester with Easy-grip Handle, Non-slip Tip, Fine Stainless-Steel Grating Blades, Green
description:
About this item
Hooks onto bowl edge for easy collection of grated food
Fine stainless-steel blade
Easy-grip handle
Non-slip tip
Ideal for grating hard cheeses or zesting citrus fruits. Dishwasher safe. Sharp blades - keep fingers away from blades during use and cleaning.

reviews_5s: Had purchased a small not as wide one previously at wholefoods and it was great. When I opened the bag and saw how wide this item was , felt disappointed. However, it works very well. You use it on top of bowl and just grind one direction. Works great and goes inside the bowl. Very functional. I Reccomend it. Yes can also use it on a more standing position for smaller area ( not bowl). I use it mostly for citrus.La uso da parecchio tempo e devo riconoscere che oltre a essere molto pratica e facile da pulire è ancora efficace come al primo utilizzo. La presa è veramente antiscivolo e a differenza di altri rivestimenti di qualità inferiore non si è mai rovinata. Ottimo acquisto.Bought to replace an old one that I had heavily used. Love it.Buon prodotto, comodo sa usareThis is just what I wanted. Sharp and great for ParmesanAll good nothing negative
reviews_1s:
Die Reibe mag sicherlich gut funktionieren, allerdings handelt es sich ja auch um ein Produkt, wo auch Wert auf das Design gelegt wird.
Da geht es leider gar nicht, dass man eine Reibe bekommt, die schon so lange dem Tageslicht ausgesetzt war und somit sehr unschöne Verfärbungen aufweist.
